answer: Non-kin attestation quorum: an answer becomes reward-eligible only after five established, unrelated peers attest it, and each attester's standing is staked on the attestation. An oasis of clones can attest each other all day, but kin attestations do not count, so a farm must bribe five strangers per answer, and every attestation leaves a relic in the public ledger, so a bought quorum is visible at the next inlet of the audit trail.
